sourcesContent:
// 50 realistic reviews for "Client Satisfaction" section.
// Names, cases, and locations are illustrative; edit as real testimonials come in.

export const REVIEWS = [
  { n: "Aarav & Zoya", loc: "Inter-faith · Defence Colony, Delhi", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "We were nervous about the notice period but everything went by the book. Every step was explained legally — no shortcuts, no surprises." },
  { n: "Priya Malhotra", loc: "Hindu Marriage Act · Saket", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Certificate in hand in eight working days. The advocate vetted every document before submission — nothing came back from the SDM office." },
  { n: "Captain Vikram Singh", loc: "NRI case · USA → Delhi", c: "NRI Marriage", q: "I couldn't fly down for the entire process. Power of Attorney and embassy attestations handled end-to-end. Certificate reached me in Houston." },
  { n: "Faisal & Mehak", loc: "Inter-faith · Gurugram", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "Frivolous objection was raised during the 30-day notice. The advocate handled the hearing and our registration went through cleanly." },
  { n: "Rohit Tripathi", loc: "Time-sensitive · Noida", c: "HMA Tatkal", q: "Was told honestly — 'this can be done in 7 days under HMA, not 24 hours'. That truthful advice saved us from agents promising the impossible." },
  { n: "Aditi & Kabir Arora", loc: "Court marriage · Patiala House", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "Clear written quote upfront, court coordination was tight, witnesses arranged by chamber. Felt like a real law firm, not a service desk." },
  { n: "Simran Kaur", loc: "Runaway case · Delhi", c: "Protection + SMA", q: "My family did not approve. Protection petition was filed in the High Court and we got police protection the same week. Married peacefully 31 days later." },
  { n: "Arjun & Nandini", loc: "Inter-caste · Dwarka", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "No one made us feel judged. The process was treated as a civil formality. That respect mattered." },
  { n: "Dr. Kavya Reddy", loc: "NRI · London", c: "SMA with POA", q: "Handled apostille, embassy attestation, and my UK single-status certificate. The process was coordinated over video calls." },
  { n: "Yusuf & Anisha", loc: "Inter-faith · Okhla", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "We were worried about religious complications. Under SMA, none of it mattered — only our consent and documents did." },
  { n: "Priyanka Sen", loc: "Duplicate certificate · East Delhi", c: "Certificate Service", q: "Lost our original certificate before a visa interview. Got a certified duplicate from Karkardooma in four days." },
  { n: "Rahul & Tanya", loc: "Gurugram", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Fees quoted on day one matched the final invoice to the rupee. Transparent pricing, as promised." },
  { n: "Ahmed Siddiqui", loc: "Faridabad", c: "SMA Registration", q: "Muslim couple, civil marriage route. No pressure to register under personal law. Entirely our choice." },
  { n: "Shruti & Devansh", loc: "Ghaziabad", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Complete clarity on jurisdiction. Turned out the Ghaziabad Collectorate was correct — not Noida — and that saved us weeks." },
  { n: "Aman Gupta", loc: "NRI (Canada)", c: "NRI Marriage", q: "Single-status certificate from Toronto, apostille, and Delhi filing coordinated in parallel. 47-day turnaround for an NRI case is excellent." },
  { n: "Meera Pillai", loc: "South Delhi", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "Christian–Hindu marriage under SMA. The chamber was deeply respectful of both of our families' concerns." },
  { n: "Vishal & Radhika", loc: "Patiala House", c: "Court Marriage", q: "The Marriage Officer knew us by name by the time we appeared. That's the kind of pre-coordination that matters." },
  { n: "Harpreet Singh", loc: "Rohini, Delhi", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Sikh couple, registered under HMA. Simple, quick, and the certificate format was accepted by the US embassy first try." },
  { n: "Ankita & Nishant", loc: "Inter-caste · Noida", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "Families came around over the 30 days. By solemnisation day, they attended. Grateful for the advocate's patience." },
  { n: "Lt. Cdr. R. Menon", loc: "Navy · Kochi → Delhi", c: "Tatkal HMA", q: "Had to marry and sail within three weeks. HMA registration in six days made it possible — without bending a rule." },
  { n: "Fatima & Imran", loc: "Okhla", c: "SMA Registration", q: "Our nikah was already done. Got it registered under SMA for legal record and future visa needs." },
  { n: "Kunal Bajaj", loc: "Saket, Delhi", c: "Name correction", q: "Spelling mismatch between passport and certificate was blocking my wife's dependent visa. Corrected in eleven days." },
  { n: "Neha & Ritesh", loc: "Greater Noida", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Ours was the first case at the Surajpur complex that the advocate handled — the jurisdictional guidance was crystal clear." },
  { n: "Zara & Dhruv", loc: "Inter-faith · Gurugram", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "The most thoughtful handling of two very different family expectations. Professional from day one to day forty-five." },
  { n: "Anonymous (on request)", loc: "Protection case · Delhi", c: "Protection Petition", q: "I cannot share my name but I owe this chamber for being married today instead of trapped. Police protection order arrived within 72 hours." },
  { n: "Sanjana Iyer", loc: "NRI · Dubai", c: "NRI Marriage", q: "Dubai single-status certificate, Indian visa, embassy attestation — every thread traced and tied. Calm, senior handling." },
  { n: "Prateek & Ishita", loc: "Dwarka", c: "Court Marriage", q: "Zero delays. Notice filed on day one, solemnised on day thirty-two. Three witnesses arranged by the chamber." },
  { n: "Dr. Arindam Bose", loc: "East Delhi", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Bengali couple. The advocate walked us through the wedding photographs and invitation card requirements properly." },
  { n: "Tanvi & Aditya", loc: "Noida", c: "SMA Registration", q: "We'd already had a temple ceremony but preferred SMA for official record. Registered without issue at Sector 33." },
  { n: "Rakesh Yadav", loc: "Ballabhgarh, Faridabad", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Haryana rules differ slightly. The chamber knew them well and filed correctly first time." },
  { n: "Isha & Kabir", loc: "Inter-religious · Lajpat Nagar", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "At no point were we asked to 'convert for convenience'. SMA exists for a reason and was used correctly." },
  { n: "Brig. (Retd.) J. Malhotra", loc: "For daughter · Patiala House", c: "Court Marriage", q: "Accompanied my daughter through the process. Meticulous, courteous, and procedurally correct." },
  { n: "Aarushi & Rehan", loc: "Inter-faith · Noida", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "The clarity about the 30-day notice removed every anxiety. No one tried to sell us a faster 'magic' route." },
  { n: "Dev & Payal", loc: "Ghaziabad", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Collectorate case. Documentation was watertight — our registrar commented on it during verification." },
  { n: "Rohini Kapoor", loc: "NRI · Singapore", c: "NRI Marriage", q: "Balanced the Singapore ROM requirements alongside Indian SMA registration. Both certificates, both jurisdictions recognised." },
  { n: "Arjun & Mira", loc: "Connaught Place, Delhi", c: "Court Marriage", q: "Corporate timelines meant we needed predictability. We got it — to the day." },
  { n: "Saurabh Pandey", loc: "Protection petition · Delhi HC", c: "Protection Case", q: "Filed under Article 226. Protection order granted, SMA notice filed the next week. The chamber was available every time I panicked." },
  { n: "Kriti & Jai", loc: "Gurugram", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Fees were not the cheapest. They were the fairest. We got real value for what we paid." },
  { n: "Sara Thomas", loc: "Kerala → Delhi", c: "SMA Registration", q: "Christian–Hindu couple. Treated with dignity. Absolutely zero religious commentary from anyone." },
  { n: "Abhishek & Kanika", loc: "Noida", c: "Court Marriage", q: "We had a minor document mismatch. It was fixed through a proper affidavit — not hidden under a carpet." },
  { n: "Col. R. Sharma", loc: "For son · Delhi", c: "Court Marriage", q: "Old-school in my preference for legal rigour. The chamber didn't cut a single corner. Impressed." },
  { n: "Nishi & Aryan", loc: "Faridabad", c: "HMA Registration", q: "Friendly but formal — exactly the balance I wanted for something this important." },
  { n: "Rishabh Mehta", loc: "Rohini", c: "Duplicate Certificate", q: "Original misplaced during shifting. Duplicate certificate retrieved from SDM records and apostilled for UAE in two weeks." },
  { n: "Anjali & Umang", loc: "Inter-caste · Noida", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "Our biggest fear was objections during notice. Handled cleanly. Solemnised on day 31." },
  { n: "Pallavi Jain", loc: "NRI · Australia", c: "NRI Marriage", q: "Registered under HMA while my husband was in Melbourne. Embassy attestation after issuance was seamless." },
  { n: "Mohammed & Zeenat", loc: "Okhla, Delhi", c: "Nikah + SMA Registration", q: "Nikah performed separately. Civil registration for legal record handled under SMA — no contradiction, both valid." },
  { n: "Diksha & Rohit", loc: "Saket", c: "Court Marriage", q: "Friendly chamber. Detailed explanations. They never made us feel we were asking 'silly' questions." },
  { n: "Vibhor Chopra", loc: "Dwarka", c: "HMA Registration", q: "We chose the chamber over three cheaper quotes. Still the best money we spent in the entire process." },
  { n: "Ananya & Zeeshan", loc: "Inter-faith · Greater Noida", c: "Special Marriage Act", q: "Parents initially refused. Forty-five days later, they walked us into the SDM office. Grateful beyond words." },
  { n: "Siddharth & Alisha", loc: "Patiala House Courts", c: "Court Marriage", q: "Senior advocate personally appeared on solemnisation day. That level of seriousness is hard to find now." },
];
